## Abstract

The Governance Architecture domain encompasses decisions related to enterprise governance frameworks, compliance requirements, architectural review processes, policy enforcement, and governance automation. This domain ensures consistent application of architectural standards and regulatory compliance across the enterprise.

Governance architecture decisions establish the foundation for architectural oversight, risk management, compliance assurance, and quality control throughout the organization.
